skills.ci-matrix: **ci-matrix** — Design and verify a multi-workflow GitHub Actions CI: one reusable quality gate (`lint.yml`), one reusable build (`build.yml`), one release entry point (`release.yml`), plus a PR gate, a pre-release cleaner and an i18n updater — six files, each with a single trigger face. Ships the per-file trigger/call matrix and the rules behind it, plus `examples/verify_workflows.py`, which checks YAML, every `run:` block via `bash -n`, `uses:` targets, the `with:` input contract and PR path filters — offline, before pushing.
skills.repo-i18n: **repo-i18n** — Manage repository multi-language docs: translations live in `assets/docs/*.json`, rendered from `assets/templates/README.md`. `repo-i18n/scripts/render_i18n.py` runs directly from the repo root and rewrites `README.md` + `docs/*/README.md` in place: `--once` is a one-shot clean run (no CI, ignores bundles, no `docs/i18n.md`); `--no-code` is the non-code mode (drops `platforms` before rendering, no platform badge).
